retrievalProfile.description: A rustic, outdoor portrait featuring a subject against weathered wood and metal textures with heavy, distressed slab-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a smiling man in casual attire positioned against a dual-textured background of vertical weathered wooden planks and a blue-and-white industrial metal sign. The composition is anchored by heavy, textured block lettering in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in white shirt contrasts against dark wood and blue metal
Textured typography mimics the weathered grain of the background
Horizontal text blocks balance the vertical lines of the wood
Subject's eye level aligns with the primary text block
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif typography with distressed internal texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-left, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white distressed text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's smile to the large white name text, then down to the smaller yellow title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame provides space for the typographic elements against the wood texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural wood browns and weathered greys (background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue and stark white (metal sign and shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white shirt/text and the dark background; generally desaturated earth tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, denim blue, and off-white

letterConstructionRules: Internal distressing and 'chipped paint' texture effects
characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded edges on all glyphs to match wood grain
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two weights of the same slab-serif family, using color and texture to differentiate hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Industrial metal sign as a secondary background element

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a white t-shirt standing against a background of vertical weathered grey wood planks on top and a blue/white industrial metal sign on the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply heavy, distressed white slab-serif text in the upper right, with a secondary line of mustard yellow slab-serif text directly below it.

verificationChecks: Text has a weathered, non-solid texture
Wood grain is vertical and visible
Subject is positioned to the left

postGenerationChecks: Is the text properly distressed to match the wood?
Is the slab-serif font heavy enough?
Does the blue metal sign look aged?
Is the subject's expression natural and approachable?
Is the color palette cohesive and earthy?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Casual Portrait] + [Background: Weathered Wood & Metal] + [Typography: Distressed Heavy Slab Serif] to create a rustic Americana aesthetic.
